details.usageInstructions:
Classic Oatmeal Recipe
Add 40 g of Bagrry’s Rolled Oats
to 250 ml of boiling milk or water and keep stirring.
Boil for 4–6 minutes over a
medium flame. Add sugar or honey to taste, if desired.
Alternatively, microwave 40 g of
Bagrry’s Rolled Oats with 250 ml of milk for 3–4 minutes.
Suggested garnishes: dates,
almonds and fresh fruits. Serve warm for a wholesome breakfast.
Overnight Oats Recipe
Combine rolled oats and chia
seeds in a small jar.
Add milk, Greek yoghurt and maple
syrup to the jar, then stir well.
Refrigerate the jar and allow the
oats to soak overnight.
